blocks.heading: A weekend for curious people
blocks.body:
Sundial Weekend is a small festival of talks, workshops, live music and very good food, held every March in an old harbour hall.

Come for one day or both. Sit in on a talk you have never heard of. Make something in a workshop. Eat lunch with strangers who will not be strangers by Sunday.

items.question: Can I come for just one day?
items.answer: Yes. Day passes cover either Saturday or Sunday.

items.question: Is the venue step-free?
items.answer: The hall, the barn and the food court are all step-free, and the quiet room has seats and low light. Tell us about anything else you need.

items.question: Will talks be recorded?
items.answer: Main Stage talks are recorded and shared two weeks later. Workshops are not.

items.question: What if it rains?
items.answer: Everything except the market is indoors. Bring a coat for the walk between buildings.

items.question: Can I get a refund?
items.answer: Up to fourteen days before the event, in full. After that you can pass your ticket to a friend.

items.question: Are there student or low-income tickets?
items.answer: Yes. A quarter of all places are pay-what-you-can. Choose the weekend pass and tell us in the form's access box.

items.question: Are children welcome?
items.answer: Under-12s come free with an adult. There is a quiet corner and colouring tables in the food court.

pages.title: Venue
pages.description: Where Sundial Weekend happens, how to get there, and what is where.

blocks.heading: Harbourside Hall
blocks.body:
An old harbour hall and the barn behind it, on the edge of Example Quay. Everything is within a two-minute walk.

## Getting here

- **Train:** Example Quay station is a ten-minute walk along the water.
- **Bike:** free supervised parking by the entrance.
- **Car:** very limited, so please share a ride.
